name: Adam
source:
A slave pet kept under Louise. Originally from a distant island nation, Louise bought him for fun.
He has a very large body and is over 3 meters tall, but he is an idiot and can't speak well.
He has a low IQ, and when he sees a woman he tries to play with her like a toy.

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=842266&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
